name: wordforms
description:
Every wordform of the lemma of a word, alphabetical, each once.

word: the word, in any form. The forms are those of its lemma, in lower case; the word itself is not repeated («диван» gives «дивана», «диване», … but not «диван»). A word the dictionary lacks gives no forms.

Example: semkit read --text "диваны" wordforms диваны write -
-> диван; дивана; диванам; диванами; диванах; диване; диванов; диваном; дивану

The step ignores the current table: the table of the wordforms replaces it, its column wordform is the working one.
